parts.text: I keep the shared picture of the airspace by managing the network of flight corridors between sites, the zones that group them, and the closures announced by the authorities. When the authorities announce planned closures with a start and end time or sudden closures that apply at once, I enter them into the system. These closures are often amended during the day, such as when an area is widened or an end time moves, and I want to know how much disruption any closure caused across customers.
